title: Miro Starter to self-hosted draw.io
summary: draw.io costs almost nothing to run and does maybe a third of what Miro does. Which third decides this.

you_lose: Real-time multiplayer, which is most of what Miro sells
Templates, voting, timers and everything built for running a workshop
Comment threads and the review flow around them
you_gain: The best diagramming tool of the lot, and it is not close for flowcharts and architecture
Diagrams as XML files you can version and diff in git
Apache-2.0, and a container that runs on the cheapest box sold

caveats: These are different products. draw.io is for diagrams; Miro is for meetings. If your team runs workshops on Miro, this is not a replacement.
Self-hosted draw.io has no collaboration server. People edit files, not a shared board.
If you want an infinite shared canvas, read the Excalidraw page instead.
